                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1x Tag: Beacon Base Blocks

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Brainsweep is just another way of transportation - in the aspect of mind.


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If I shoot my mind somewhere connected higher, some stable beam within structure of stable spatial constraints, my mind and body will go through the Sea and teleport to it, even if the location is out of my casting ambit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sometimes for locations too far away, the beacon beam might not be connected instantly, and trying again a few times may help.


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Self Exposure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source: HexAutomata

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      I am mind, and mind is media... Body is the vessel, heavy and fragile... I shall expose my mind, taking me out of the vessel, I shall see more, I ...
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The spell I casted on all those poor villagers, could be applied on myself creating a loop-back - a moment the vessel and the spirit split, a glance on my body, all I need to understand myself, and expose my spirit to the Sea...


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      I have seen! I have seen the Sea!

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The mediafied me shall gain more control all across the world, grasping and manipulating the nature. The spirit finally gets freed from the vessel.


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Spells Inside Reactive Focus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source: HexAutomata

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Using Quantum Media Entanglement effect between me and the triggerer, there are several tricks I can play with exclusively inside an event of Reactive Focus.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      However, I have the feeling that, if I cast these spells outside the Focus, something REALLY BAD might happen.


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Quantum Swap

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 描画
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • パレット
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          お使いのブラウザはパターンの視覚化をサポートしていません。パターンコード: aqaedwaqded

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Swaps me and the triggering entity spatially, at cost of half of a dust. Takes no effect if there's no such entity (for example, hurt event triggered by environmental damage).


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Klein's Reflection (→ any)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 描画
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • パレット
